name: CC0 1.0 Universal
notes: Public domain dedication. Composes with everything.

name: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 IGO
notes: Used by UN agencies. Attribution required; disputes go to arbitration rather than national courts.

name: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0
notes: SHARE-ALIKE. Derivatives must carry the same licence.

name: Open Database License 1.0
notes: SHARE-ALIKE for derived databases. Mixing into another dataset propagates ODbL. OpenStreetMap uses this.

name: Government open data (terms unspecified)
notes: Published by a government body without an explicit licence. Treated as reusable with attribution but NOT verified. Flag to users.

name: Reuse terms unknown
notes: No licence statement found. Treated as maximally restrictive: do not publish derived work without review.
